listGroupMembers.name: List Group Members
listGroupMembers.cmd: Get-MgGroupMember -GroupId (Get-MgGroup -Filter "displayName eq '{GroupName}'").Id | ForEach-Object { Get-MgUser -UserId $_.Id } | Select-Object DisplayName, UserPrincipalName, Mail

requireMFA.name: Require MFA Re-registration

getDeviceInfo.name: Get Device Info
getDeviceInfo.cmd: Get-MgDeviceManagementManagedDevice -Filter "deviceName eq '{DeviceName}'" | Select-Object DeviceName, UserPrincipalName, OperatingSystem, OSVersion, ComplianceState, LastSyncDateTime, EnrolledDateTime, Manufacturer, Model, SerialNumber

listNonCompliant.name: List Non-Compliant Devices
listNonCompliant.cmd: Get-MgDeviceManagementManagedDevice -Filter "complianceState eq 'noncompliant'" | Select-Object DeviceName, UserPrincipalName, OperatingSystem, ComplianceState, LastSyncDateTime | Format-Table -AutoSize

syncDevice.name: Sync Device

listUserDevices.name: List User Devices
listUserDevices.cmd: Get-MgDeviceManagementManagedDevice -Filter "userPrincipalName eq '{UserPrincipalName}'" | Select-Object DeviceName, OperatingSystem, OSVersion, ComplianceState, LastSyncDateTime, Manufacturer, Model | Format-Table -AutoSize

rebootDevice.name: Reboot Device

wipeDevice.name: Wipe Device (Factory Reset)

retireDevice.name: Retire Device

addToSharedMbx.name: Add to Shared Mailbox

getSiteInfo.name: Get Site Info
getSiteInfo.cmd: Get-SPOSite -Identity "{SiteUrl}" | Select-Object Title, Url, Owner, StorageUsageCurrent, StorageQuota, Template, SharingCapability

checkPerms.name: Check Site Permissions
checkPerms.cmd: Get-SPOUser -Site "{SiteUrl}" | Select-Object DisplayName, LoginName, IsSiteAdmin, Groups
